parameters.content:
## Add images to a post (multi-image posts)
**/themanh <id>**: add the images just sent to the group (15 minutes, several images/files at once). **/xoaanh <id> <n|het>**: remove extra images. **/xepanh <id> <order>**: reorder. **/xemanh <id>**: view the set.
Image 1 = main image (column Link ảnh), images 2.. in column **Ảnh thêm** (one link per line, max 9). If the post has no main image/cover yet, the first square/landscape image fills them. When posting: Fanpage album, Zalo OA images in the body, group gets a grid image.
